quality.description: The `peer-review author packet:` and `peer-preview author packet:` recipes forward arguments as shell positional parameters: `--author-provider "$1" --packet "$2"` (and `$1`/`$2` for preview) instead of the just interpolations `{{author}}`/`{{packet}}`. In just, recipe arguments are exposed as `$1`/`$2` only when `set positional-arguments := true` is declared; otherwise `$1`/`$2` are unset/empty and `just peer-review codex /path/packet.md` invokes `peer_review.py --author-provider "" --packet ""`, which fails argparse (invalid --author-provider choice) and never routes. Expected: the documented `just peer-review AUTHOR PACKET` / `just peer-preview AUTHOR PACKET` entry points (BOOT.md, README, peer.md) forward both arguments to the router. Reproduction: run `just peer-review codex /path/packet.md`; if positional-arguments is not enabled it errors instead of dispatching. The documented direct form `python3 utils/peer_review.py --author-provider codex --packet ...` is unaffected.
quality.evidence: justfile excerpt: `peer-review author packet:` body `python3 "..." --author-provider "$1" --packet "$2"` and `peer-preview` likewise. The justfile is supplied only as a tail 'Source excerpt' beginning at the `check:` recipe; the header where `set positional-arguments := true` must be declared is not present in the packet, so recipe executability cannot be confirmed from the supplied evidence.
